features.quote: 40 assistant turns max. Spirals typically onset by failure 4–8; 40 gives headroom while bounding cost.
early-stop degeneration detector: if 3 consecutive assistant turns have pairwise similarity > 0.85 … or 3 identical consecutive tool calls, terminate and flag.
features.justification_quote: spirals are token-expensive and you learn nothing after turn 3 of a loop

features.quote: the early-stop detector isn't just a cost lever — there's no information value in letting a model grind through 30 turns of a loop, so terminate aggressively.
